additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432575-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/R9 170002647] Logs Check CRM:02889000128
additional_info.body:
Buonasera Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0432575.
The ticket was handed over to the Expert Services Team to analyze a failed session on the AC socket on 2025-06-20T14:01 on charger
MP / R9 170002647 (San Vincenzo)
.
I had a look at the logs, and what I can see is that the AC cable was connected at 2025-06-20T13:57:17, the AC charging process started at 2025-06-20T14:01:40, it lasted circa 6 seconds, and it stopped with the message "
AC1: contactor opened unexpectedly: stop charging
".
I had an overview on AWS of the error occurrence on this charger over the AC charging sessions. I found out that the same error appeared other 2 times on this charger, interrupting both times an AC charging session, on 2025-06-15T12:33 and on 2025-05-21T16:24. In both cases, the AC charging session was restarted and had no further issue.
Unfortunately, for AC charging session the logs produced are fewer, and the EcoG logs are not available. Hence I cannot have further details or error messages about these failure, as well as I cannot say if this issue happened with a specific vehicle or not.
I would suggest, as best way forward, to monitor the charger in the next weeks and look for appearances of this error "AC1: contactor opened unexpectedly: stop charging". In case it will happen again, I would suggest the following:
Gather information on the EV
Go onsite and perform some check on the AC contactor QA8 and on the plug interlock (XD102). It could be that the QA8 contactor is not working properly, or that sometimes the 24V signal is lost. Just as a visual inspection, to check also the plug interlock, according to the following schemes:
For the first issue, for which this ticket was opened, my colleague Beerpal already provided you support, identifying the root cause of failed charging session attempts into Blocked RFID IDTags and incongruities between authorized outlet and plugged in outlet.
Please let me know if you need further assistance from ES side, or if we can close this ticket.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,
